# Fixture Brand · DESIGN (TEST FIXTURE)

Never shipped, never exported to a team. `npm run check` builds this brand with deliberately garish values
(magenta, lime, a Courier accent face) and fails if any real brand's colour appears in its outputs or if any
brand-dependent semantic token keeps a real brand's value. That is the proof that a rebrand is a token edit.
